objects.name: base
objects.prompt: A large flat-screen television mounted on a simple stand, viewed from a high top-down RPG angle. Wide rectangular black screen with a thin dark frame, clearly visible screen surface, subtle metallic details, realistic proportions. Clean 2D pixel art, low top-down perspective, simple shading. Screen turned off and solid dark black, no images, no text, no people, no background, no extra objects.
